accountTrackDisclosure.uploaded: A device-derived pseudonymous account track is included with each usage and quota record in the loopback-only local preview.
accountTrackDisclosure.purpose: It links records only for the same provider account inside this anonymous participant for private calibration and integrity checks.
accountTrackDisclosure.lifecycle: It survives logout, account recovery, and security reset, and changes after central re-enrollment or local export-identity rotation.
accountTrackDisclosure.limitations: It does not provide cross-device continuity, provider-account ownership proof, unique-person proof, eligibility, or anti-Sybil evidence.
accountTrackDisclosure.publication: It is never included in community output.
accountTrackDisclosure.deletion: It is deleted with the participant's central data. Deleting a local export alone does not rotate the local export identity.
